details:
One feature, which was a really popular mod, was called Avatar Hider. this allowed you to Hide ppls models completely in a radios around you. So anyone within 6m you could see, but outside of 6m ppls models will go invisible. (turn off completely, so you only see name tag) This is a really needed feature for VRChat as worlds which end up having 50+ more ppl become basically unplayable because your framerate is bellow 30fps. (even with avatars in safety settings already off, so you just see robot man) I feel like having this in the safety settings of VRChat would be great and it also means quest users would be able to run bigger group worlds too. you could even have a player limit on it as an optional setting, so lets say if a world goes over 30 ppl, this safety setting starts in to help with framerate.
I know this kinda takes away the feeling of been in a large group of ppl, which some might like. but looking at MMOs (finial fantasy 14) this is a feature which works well.
title: requesting Avatar Hider for safety settings
